notes: Labels define "pattern" the same way the generator does: results show agreement with that definition, not how often real markets are manipulated, and nothing about intent.
benign_fill_wall: a large order that rests and is then FILLED still looks like a wall while it rests — counted as a false positive, because a wall alone cannot tell liquidity from a spoof.
precision = flags matching a labelled pattern ÷ all flags; recall = labelled episodes with ≥ 1 matching flag ÷ labelled episodes.

assumptions.note: Order-book imbalance and spread are computed from the synthetic book itself. Volume is generated separately and its link to labelled episodes (volumeCoupling) is an ASSUMPTION; sensitivity.volumeCouplingOff shows the composite without it. All signals use data available at the flag time only (no look-ahead). Synthetic replay — not evidence about real-market manipulation.
